text:
Priya (People Ops): FYI — Samir Patel (new IC) arriving Mon 9am PST. Hes remote but traveling and wants his company laptop delivered to the Marriott Marquis (staying Sun night). He also mentioned his passport is expired and he has a Canadian PR card + a foreign national ID. Candidate asked if we can do a remote I-9 with a local notary or if we need an in-person drop-in. Also requested Hindi translator for day-1 orientation.

Ben (Hiring Manager): He can do a drop-in if thats easier. Payroll sign-up depends on I-9 completion — what doc set would clear this? Dont want hold-ups.

Lina (Onboarding): Quick I-9 refresher: we need either List A OR one from List B + one from List C. Expired passport = NOT acceptable. If he has a valid PR card (List A) thats fine. If not, we can accept a gov photo ID (B) + SSN card (C). If SSN missing, we can still complete the form but payroll may need SSN later. CCing background check for vendor impact.

Background Check Desk: CheckFast notes — no SSN on file and international mailing address may delay verification. We can run an ID-only verification and mark SSN pending; candidate must sign consent ASAP. If Samir provides a valid List A doc (e.g., Canadian PR) we can proceed faster.

Recruiter Jo: Samir says he DOES have a Canadian PR card (physical) and can bring it. Hes willing to come to SF office Mon and meet at 10:30 for the I-9 + translator. Hes nervous about hotel delivery — asked if we can label it for pick-up.

Priya (People Ops): Proposed plan: 1) Schedule 10:30am in-person I-9 drop-in at HQ Mon (translator booked), 2) If he cant make it, fallback is remote notary via NotaryNow (company-approved) — Lina will send link, 3) Candidate to upload a photo of the PR card + any gov photo ID to our secure intake portal by EOD Fri. If PR card is acceptable, background check can proceed without SSN for now.

IT-bot: Shipping OK to hotel if label format = exactly below and includes mobile:

```
Hold for: Samir Patel / Redwood Inference
Marriott Marquis SF
Assign to: Front Desk - Guest Pickup
Guest check-in name: Samir Patel
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123
```

Also add AUP signature before laptop handoff; we'll send AUP link on Friday. VPN/profile will be prepped but needs asset tag sign-off.

Lina (Onboarding): Ill book the 10:30 slot, confirm a Hindi interpreter, and put the NotaryNow fallback into the calendar invite. Priya — can you send Samir the secure upload link and ask for PR card photo + any secondary ID? :thumbsup: 

Ben (Hiring Manager): Thanks — Ill ping Samir now to confirm 10:30 and the translator. If hes out of town, we switch to notary. Appreciate the quick coordination!
